[raw subtype: hemosiderotic] B: Posterior view of the same patient showing the caption-described hyperpigmented macules and patches on the trunk overlying the yellowish discoloration of hemosiderotic diffuse normolipemic plane xanthoma; real patient image of a configured disease manifestation. [raw subtype: hemosiderotic] C: Clinical photograph of the same patient's lower extremities showing the generalized yellowish discoloration with overlying hyperpigmented macules and patches on the extremities, matching the caption and the configured disease hemosiderotic diffuse normolipemic plane xanthoma. in_text_mentions: history of topical agent, herbal, sun, or heat exposure. Our patient had a medical condition of hypertension and benign prostatic hyperplasia, and he was receiving amlodipine, enalapril, doxazosin, and finasteride as part of his treatment. Dermatologic examination revealed generalized yellowish discoloration with overlying hyperpigmented macules and patches on the trunk and all extremities (Fig 1). There was no hepatosplenomegaly or lymphadenopathy.Fig 1A 67-year-old man with generalized yellowish discoloration with overlying hyperpigmented macules and patches on the trunk and all extremities.
